Your thoughts: It was also because the web link used ebro, ebrodb would have been more logical. I am not convinced they need to be the same. Reference to project name, file name and weblink are not consistently used in the code and that is not helpful.

Today the code conflates them (parent() derivation, basename matching) - that is the actual ebro bug. Define them once per trip/virttrip and let the retire matcher key on the explicit link, not the basename. Then ebro-slug != spanjeebro-id is fine by design.
